description: The full record of one residency, visa or citizenship program: requirements, minimum income or investment, stay rules, years to permanent residency and citizenship, fees, processing time, legal basis and sources, plus its country summary. Use the program_id from find_visas, get_country_profile or get_recent_changes, or a program name.

program.description: A program_id such as "panama-friendly-nations-visa", or part of a program name such as "Paraguay investor".
